title: The Bridges of Madison County
author: Robert James Waller
summary: A lonely Iowa farm wife meets a travelling photographer who has come to shoot the area's covered bridges. Over four days, they fall into a love that she will carry quietly for the rest of her life.
readIf: you like a short, wistful love story about a road not taken.
skipIf: you want a lively romance with banter and a tidy happy ending.

pairings.reason: Another sentimental romance told as a look back across a lifetime, with a gentler ending.
A quiet, restrained story of love left unspoken, with more literary depth.
The grand, tragic version of a married woman choosing love over duty.
